_source: Промпты для концепт-референсов локаций (ChatGPT / любой генератор картинок). Описания — [меню] LOCATIONS-MENU.md, блоки — [меню] MINE-SHARES.md + [вики 26.10] HANDBOOK-WIKI.md, боссы и приёмы — client-audit/RESOURCEPACK-BOSSES.md, идеи — docs/research/location-ideas.md (поиск в сети 26.10). Образец стиля — assets/screenshots/style-ref-*.jpg (Подножье горы и Пустотная крепость, их владелец выбрал как «наш стиль»). Сборщик: node scripts/build-location-prompts.mjs
style: STYLE - THE MOST IMPORTANT RULE: match the attached screenshot of our game exactly. It is a Roblox game that looks like vanilla Minecraft: the world is built ONLY from full cubes (one block is the smallest unit; stairs, slabs, fences, trapdoors, lanterns and banners are allowed), every block face has a flat 16x16 pixel texture like Minecraft's default textures, simple flat shading, plain daylight sky. NOT allowed: tiny voxels smaller than a block, voxel-art diorama look, rounded or beveled cubes, glow and bloom, painterly or cinematic lighting, cartoon chibi characters. Detail comes from many full blocks and block-sized props. Camera like a player's screenshot in Minecraft. SCALE: the player is 2 blocks tall; main paths are 4-6 blocks wide because players fight each other (PvP) here. COMPOSITION: one hero landmark visible from the arrival point, 3-4 districts with different character, height variety (bridges, terraces, rooftops, underground).
gameplay: GAMEPLAY PIECES THAT MUST BE VISIBLE: (1) the mine - a square pit 32x32 blocks wide and 12 blocks deep, filled with the mine blocks listed above, ladders on its 4 walls; (2) the arrival platform and a small block-buyer stall right next to the mine; (3) {ARENA}.
arena: the boss arena - an open round plaza about 60 blocks across with 4 thick pillars, reachable from at least 3 sides
summit: the summit plaza - the most beautiful spot of the level, open, about 50 blocks across
island: The whole level is a floating island high in the sky (every level floats at its own height): edges are cliffs or walls, nothing else on the horizon except sky.
sheet: OUTPUT: one landscape 3:2 image laid out as a 2x2 concept sheet with thin gaps: top-left - top-down map of the whole level; top-right - eye-level view from the arrival platform toward the mine with the hero landmark behind it; bottom-left - {PANEL3} seen from player height; bottom-right - close-up of 6-8 signature props built from blocks. No text, no labels, no UI, no logos, no watermark.

locations.name: Рынок
locations.ru: Шумный тюремный базар (идея: Гранд-базар в Стамбуле): ряды полосатых навесов сходятся к площади с шахтой; посреди рынка мостовая провалилась — фонтан наполовину ушёл в провал, лестница ведёт в склеп Короля нежити.
locations.prompt: LEVEL: "Market", a noisy prison black market where everything is sold, inside a stone prison wall with guard towers. Rows of market stalls with striped wool awnings (red, yellow and lime wool, stripes 1 block wide) on spruce fence posts converge on a central square; the mine is dug right there, stalls pushed aside around the pit. DETAILS: half-timbered stall backs (stripped spruce logs and spruce planks) set 1 block behind the counters, barrels of melons and hay, scales made of fences and pressure plates, chickens in iron-bar cages, hand carts, flag bunting on chains between roofs, a cauldron on a campfire, an open trapdoor under a counter with a pickaxe (smugglers dig under the stalls), cobblestone-andesite-gravel street noise. MINE BLOCKS: red wool, yellow wool, lime wool. HERO LANDMARK: in the far square the pavement has caved in: a fountain is half sunk into a jagged hole, cracked stone bricks turn into soul soil at its edge, a broken staircase leads down. BOSS ARENA: a crypt under the market - vaults of upside-down stone brick stairs, deepslate bricks, bone blocks, skulls and cobwebs, soul lanterns, a throne of bone blocks with a gold crown, 4 crypt pillars. The boss is the Undead King: dark missiles, exploding skulls, a giant ghost sword, ghouls guard him. MOOD: bright busy day above, dead silent blue-green soul-lantern crypt below.

locations.name: Лепреконовая долина
locations.ru: Зелёная чаша холмов с ирландским «фейри-фортом» (кольцевой вал); радуга из цветного цемента падает в котёл золота; в центре форта кривой боярышник и тотем Лесного духа.
locations.prompt: LEVEL: "Leprechaun Valley", a green bowl of clover hills where leprechaun gold is hidden. A rainbow built from 7 colours of concrete powder (arc 2 blocks wide) spans the valley and falls into a cauldron full of gold blocks. DETAILS: clover meadows of moss carpet, mossy cobblestone standing stones (menhirs), a winding stream with raw gold in the water and small stone bridges, round-door burrow houses in the hills, giant red mushroom blocks, a fairy ring of mushrooms, a cultists' camp with green wool tents, campfires and banners, glow lichen fireflies, moss and grass block noise. MINE BLOCKS: yellow, orange, lime, purple and red concrete powder - it looks like a rainbow quarry. HERO LANDMARK: an Irish fairy fort - a double ring wall of coarse dirt and moss with a moat - and inside it a crooked hawthorn tree with a carved totem pole of stripped oak logs in its roots (faces of carved stone, horns of oak fences). BOSS ARENA: the inside of the fairy fort around the totem - ritual stones, lanterns, roots breaking the ground. The boss is the Forest Spirit, a horned dark spirit; cultists (shamans and lost explorers with lanterns) guard its totem. MOOD: sunny and green in the valley, misty inside the fort.

locations.name: Замок
locations.ru: Белый готический замок из кварца, испорченный вороньими гнёздами и копотью (контраст белого и чёрного); донжон «Белая башня» с вороньим гнездом на шпиле, как вороны Тауэра.
locations.prompt: LEVEL: "Castle", an old white gothic castle with high walls and dark corridors, spoiled by raven nests and black soot - white and black contrast readable from far away. Walls in a gradient from deepslate bricks at the bottom through polished andesite to quartz bricks and quartz blocks at the top, buttresses every 4 blocks, quartz pillars on the corners, quartz slab battlements, arrow slits with black glass. DETAILS: raven nests of dark oak fences and black wool on the cornices, black carpets as raven flocks on the towers, raven cages of iron bars, a drawbridge on chains, knight armour on armour stands, a dark corridor with soul lanterns every 6 blocks, torn black banners with a white wing, ivy on the west wall, the cursed knight's tombstone. MINE BLOCKS: quartz block and chiseled quartz block - the torn-up palace square in front of the keep. HERO LANDMARK: the keep - a tall White Tower with a huge raven nest on its spire. BOSS ARENA: the courtyard under the keep ringed with knight statues, black feathers on the ground, 4 quartz pillars. The boss is the Raven Knight: crow swarms, black fog, spikes from the ground, a summoned flying axe. MOOD: overcast grey day, cold light, ravens everywhere.

locations.name: Изнанка
locations.ru: Мёртвая копия обычного американского пригорода (как Хокинс): дома в чёрных лозах, куски улиц парят в красном небе, пепел; дом Крила с часами на парящем острове.
locations.prompt: LEVEL: "The Upside Down", a dead copy of an ordinary small American suburb where nothing is what it seems. Houses and streets covered with black vines (dark oak leaves, twisting and weeping vines, patches of sculk), torn-off pieces of road (black concrete with yellow markings) and boulders float in a dark red sky, ash drifts in the air (white carpet and snow), red lightning made of red stained glass. DETAILS: overturned cars and lamp posts, dead telephone poles of fences, pulsing gates in walls (cracks of crimson hyphae and shroomlights), a wall with a string of light bulbs and an alphabet painted under it, cocoons of nether wart blocks, a bicycle by a fence. Floating islands are upside-down cones of dirt with hanging roots. MINE BLOCKS: dark oak leaves. HERO LANDMARK: a Victorian mansion lifted on a floating island, a grandfather clock hanging over its porch. BOSS ARENA: small islands in the red void below the mansion joined into a cracked square, portal rifts in the ground, 4 broken lamp posts as pillars. The boss is Vecna, a creature of flesh and darkness, with demogorgon-like minions. MOOD: dark, red light from below, blue from above, fog - horror but readable.

locations.name: Киото
locations.ru: Храм на склоне как Киёмидзу-дэра: деревянная сцена на сваях над сакуровой долиной, к ней ведёт тоннель торий как в Фусими-Инари; рядом пагода.
locations.prompt: LEVEL: "Kyoto", a city of blooming sakura and ancient temples where the samurai Hanashiguro fights. A hillside temple like Kiyomizu-dera: a wooden stage on a tall grid of stripped spruce log stilts overhangs a valley of cherry trees, a tunnel of 20 red torii gates (red and black concrete) standing close together climbs to it like Fushimi Inari. DETAILS: stone lanterns (stone brick walls and lanterns), a koi pond with an arched red bridge, bamboo groves, pink carpet petals on the ground, a dry zen garden with waves of smooth quartz slabs, paper lanterns, fox statues, curved roofs of dark oak stairs and slabs with tips raised by 1 block, a three-stream waterfall under the stage. Cherry crowns: pink wool in the core, cherry leaves at the edges. MINE BLOCKS: pink wool with scattered sea lanterns - in a temple courtyard. HERO LANDMARK: a three- or five-storey pagoda next to the temple stage. BOSS ARENA: the temple stage itself, wooden floor, 4 red pillars, view over the valley; the ghost of his wife appears by the pond. The boss is the samurai Hanashiguro and the ghost of his beloved: rain of arrows, ghost spears, kusarigama, shuriken. MOOD: soft spring day, calm beauty with tension.

locations.name: Ферма
locations.ru: Идеальная лоскутная ферма с цветными полосами грядок, вид с холма; в центре мельница, на краю огромное древнее дерево-энт — спящий Грут.
locations.prompt: LEVEL: "Farm", the well-kept part of a big farm: a perfect patchwork of coloured crop stripes seen from a hill. Stripes every 5 blocks of wheat, carrots, green wool bushes and melons, water channels under spruce trapdoors, dirt paths with coarse dirt edges. DETAILS: a windmill with white wool sails on a cobblestone-to-stone-brick base, a brick silo with a dome, a scarecrow of hay bales and a carved pumpkin, beehives, a well, haystacks, a pumpkin cart, a farm stall with produce, oak fences with gates, composters, a red farmhouse, chicken coops, sheep in a pen. MINE BLOCKS: melons, pumpkins and green wool - a giant harvest pit. HERO LANDMARK: the windmill on the hill. BOSS ARENA: a round clearing at the edge of the fields in front of a huge ancient tree - a 5x5 trunk with a face of stripped oak logs and branch-arms resting on the ground (the sleeping Ent), 4 old trees as pillars. The boss is Groot, an Ent King: branches erupt from the ground, leaf storms, he summons tree minions. MOOD: warm golden summer afternoon.

locations.name: Амбар
locations.ru: Та же ферма через много лет, тёмный хэллоуин-вариант: покосившийся красный амбар с провалившейся крышей, сквозь которую растёт дерево; поле заросло светильниками Джека.
locations.prompt: LEVEL: "Barn", the same farm many years later, the old neglected part: overgrown and littered. A huge sagging red barn with a caved-in roof and a tree growing through the hole, glowing pumpkins inside. Faded walls of mixed red terracotta, brown terracotta and stripped dark oak logs; vines, tall grass and moss carpet climbing the walls. DETAILS: jack o'lanterns in the weeds, a rusty tractor of iron blocks and orange terracotta, a broken windmill without sails, crooked fences with missing sections, a scarecrow with a burning pumpkin head, junk heaps of coarse dirt, barrels and chains, cobwebs in windows, a broken silo, an abandoned cart, a raven on a post, candles on hay bales, podzol paths. MINE BLOCKS: jack o'lanterns - in front of the barn doors. HERO LANDMARK: the broken red barn. BOSS ARENA: the overgrown barnyard behind it with root mounds where creatures spawn, 4 old silos as pillars. The boss is the Forest Guardian, a giant of roots and bark; while its creatures live, no weapon can hurt it. MOOD: autumn dusk, fog, orange pumpkin light.

locations.name: Врата края
locations.ru: Острова из эндерняка над пустотой, плантации хоруса рядами как виноградники, шпили из чёрного стекла и пурпурного цемента; монументальная обсидиановая арка Врат.
locations.prompt: LEVEL: "End Gates", the gates of the End among chorus plantations and strange minerals. End stone islands over a starry void, their undersides with purpur pillar stalactites, bridges without railings between them. DETAILS: chorus plants in neat rows like a vineyard, crystal spires that go from black stained glass at the base to magenta concrete at the top, end rods instead of torches, magenta banners on the spires, shulker boxes, a dragon head, floating debris, a ring of 10 obsidian pillars, reaper scythes stuck into the stone, end stone brick paths. MINE BLOCKS: magenta concrete with black stained glass. HERO LANDMARK: a monumental obsidian gate arch over 20 blocks tall with purpur pillar columns, a shimmering black-and-magenta film inside it. BOSS ARENA: a round obsidian platform in front of the arch with a ring of glowing runes and 4 obsidian pillars. The boss is the Reaper, death with a scythe: he teleports, draws a soul circle on the ground, slams the ground. MOOD: night, starry void, quiet.

locations.name: Древо
locations.ru: Небесная шахта 1 (силуэт — ствол): комок земли, оплетённый корнями; исполинский ствол пробивает облака, корни свисают на 30–40 блоков под островом.
locations.prompt: LEVEL: "The Tree", the first sky mine: a ball of earth wrapped in roots, pierced by a colossal tree trunk; roots hang 30-40 blocks below the island into the clouds. The path up to the sky mines starts here. A trunk 9-13 blocks wide with a hollow entrance and a spiral stair inside; bark mixed from spruce wood, dark oak wood and stripped spruce wood; the crown in patches of oak leaves, azalea leaves and flowering azalea; roots taper from blocks to stairs to fences to hanging roots. DETAILS: rope bridges of spruce fences and chains between branches, lanterns on branches, birdhouses, bracket mushrooms on the trunk, vines and glow lichen, a waterfall falling off the edge, a banner signpost up, basket lifts. MINE BLOCKS: white concrete - like hardened sky sap in a bowl between the roots. SUMMIT: a wooden deck in the crown above the clouds. MOOD: early morning, earthy greens and browns, airy height. Clouds under the island are white wool and snow blocks.

locations.name: Церковь
locations.ru: Небесная шахта 2 (силуэт — шпиль): белая готическая базилика на узком утёсе, шпиль протыкает облако; неф из витражей как Сент-Шапель.
locations.prompt: LEVEL: "The Church", the second sky mine: a white gothic basilica on a narrow cliff above the clouds, its spire pierces a cloud. A nave without walls like Sainte-Chapelle: between the buttresses stained glass goes from floor to vault (light blue, cyan and white glass with a little yellow). Walls of calcite, diorite and polished diorite, vault ribs of quartz pillars, flying buttresses of stairs, walls set 1 block behind the columns. DETAILS: a rose window, pews of spruce stairs, a pulpit and lectern, a bell tower with a bell, candles on the steps, a small graveyard of stone brick walls, gargoyles, an organ of iron-bar pipes, a path of cloud slabs to the porch, banners with a cross. MINE BLOCKS: clay - in a broken gap of the nave floor, as if mining inside the church. SUMMIT: the bell tower top with the bell. MOOD: noon, cool blue light through glass, peaceful. Clouds of white wool below.

locations.name: Чистилище
locations.ru: Небесная шахта 3 (силуэт — спиральная гора): песчаная гора из 7 террас как у Данте, оранжевый закат в дымке, души ждут; зигзаг-лестница как Бом-Жезуш.
locations.prompt: LEVEL: "Purgatory", the third sky mine: a sandstone mountain of 7 spiral terraces like Dante's Purgatory, where souls wait for their hour. Gradient up the mountain from red sandstone to sandstone to smooth sandstone, terraces with overhangs of stairs and slabs, cut sandstone edges. DETAILS: queues of pale translucent soul figures (white stained glass), giant hourglasses of glass and sand, 7 carved relief slabs (one per sin), a zigzag stairway with fountains on the landings like Bom Jesus do Monte, waiting benches, obelisks, banner awnings, decorated pots, dead bushes, a band of campfires and soul campfires on the last terrace. A gate with three steps at the foot, an angel statue on top. MINE BLOCKS: chiseled sandstone - a quarry on one of the terraces where souls haul stones. SUMMIT: the plaza with the angel at the top. MOOD: hazy orange sunset, melancholic and quiet.

locations.name: Эдем
locations.ru: Небесная шахта 4 (силуэт — широкий плоский сад): сад, разделённый двумя реками на четыре части, Древо жизни в центре; первый по-настоящему цветной уровень.
locations.prompt: LEVEL: "Eden", the fourth sky mine: a wide flat garden island divided by two rivers into four sectors, with the Tree of Life in the centre - the first truly colourful level. Grass mixed in patches with moss and podzol, river banks of mud, moss carpet and flowers with no straight line. DETAILS: flower beds in single-colour rows, arches of azalea leaves, a pond with lily pads and sea pickles, a cherry plank bridge, trellises with vines, beehives, apple trees with red dots, a serpent of green terracotta coiled around the trunk, a fountain, pink petals on the grass, a hedge around the garden, deer and rabbits. MINE BLOCKS: brown mushroom blocks - a meadow of giant umbrella mushrooms under the tree. HERO LANDMARK: the pink-blossoming Tree of Life (cherry leaves, flowering azalea and pink wool). SUMMIT: the flowery hill under the Tree of Life. MOOD: radiant spring noon.

locations.name: Херувимы
locations.ru: Небесная шахта 5 (силуэт — кольца-колёса): обитель внутри гигантских наклонённых золотых колец («колесо в колесе»); купол-ротонда с шестикрылыми херувимами как в Святой Софии.
locations.prompt: LEVEL: "Cherubim", the fifth sky mine: an abode inside giant tilted golden rings, a wheel within a wheel, blinding gold everywhere. Gold that shimmers: gold blocks mixed with raw gold blocks, yellow concrete and honeycomb blocks; rings built from slabs and stairs so the tilted circles read smoothly; dome mosaics of yellow glazed terracotta framed with quartz bricks. DETAILS: wings of quartz stairs and slabs, eye-like observers along the rings, halos of gold blocks with end rods, harps of chains and iron bars, trumpet angel statues, an ark with two cherubs on its lid, golden stairs, pearlescent froglights, garlands of shroomlights, cloud puffs. MINE BLOCKS: snow blocks - a cloud field in the middle of the rings. HERO LANDMARK: a domed rotunda with four six-winged cherubs on the dome, like in Hagia Sophia. SUMMIT: the gallery under the dome. MOOD: golden hour, dazzling white and gold.

locations.name: Врата
locations.ru: Небесная шахта 6 (силуэт — арка на оси): строго симметричный остров, мост-дамба над морем облаков к жемчужно-золотой арке, за которой только свет.
locations.prompt: LEVEL: "The Gates", the sixth sky mine: a strictly symmetric island on one axis, a causeway over a sea of clouds leading to a monumental pearl-and-gold arch with nothing but light beyond it. Gate leaves of white glazed terracotta, calcite and pearlescent froglights in a jasper wall (prismarine, dark prismarine, white quartz stripes), two guardian angels on the sides. DETAILS: gate bars of iron bars and gold, a gatekeeper's lectern with a book, 12 foundation stones of different colours, a road of yellow stained glass over gold blocks (gold like glass), rows of pylons with torches shrinking toward the gate (forced perspective), banners of 12 tribes, cloud steps, fountains on the sides, a beacon beam rising behind the gate. MINE BLOCKS: smooth sandstone - the paved parade square in front of the gate. HERO LANDMARK: the pearly gates. SUMMIT: the top of the steps right at the open gates. MOOD: bright white light, solemn, epic scale.

locations.name: Рай
locations.ru: Небесная шахта 7 (силуэт — белая роза-амфитеатр): огромная белая роза из ярусов-лепестков как Эмпирей у Доре, столп света в центре; алое ядро — шахта.
locations.prompt: LEVEL: "Paradise", the seventh and last sky mine, the summit only the best prisoners reach: a huge white rose of concentric tiers like Dore's Empyrean, a pillar of light in the centre, nothing around but shining clouds. Almost monochrome - white concrete, quartz, calcite, snow blocks and white wool differ only by texture; lights hidden under slabs so the tiers glow from inside; radial symmetry with 8 or 12 rays. DETAILS: petal tiers of quartz slabs, thrones on the tiers, angel silhouettes in a ring, a golden river around the island (water under yellow stained glass), birds of paradise on banners, white birch trees with white wool leaves, a marble peristyle gallery, small floating islets with fountains, end rod beams pointing up, pink petals and red flowers near the core. MINE BLOCKS: red mushroom blocks - the scarlet heart of the rose, the only saturated spot. HERO LANDMARK: the rose amphitheatre with the pillar of light. SUMMIT: the innermost tier by the light. MOOD: brightest level of the game, pure white glow.

locations.name: Нефтезавод (по желанию)
locations.ru: По желанию (у нас её ещё нет): тёмный ржавый завод, разрываемый изнутри — переломленная ректификационная колонна, факел, из трещин сочится фиолетовое «нечто» (плачущий обсидиан).
locations.prompt: LEVEL: "Oil Refinery", a place where technology gave way to chaos: a dark rusty plant torn apart from within, purple matter seeping through cracks. Rust in patches of weathered, exposed and oxidized copper with iron blocks; metal of smooth stone, polished deepslate and deepslate tiles with yellow concrete accents; cracks of crying obsidian, amethyst and purple stained glass spreading over the metal. DETAILS: a tank farm of cylinders with floating roofs, spherical gas holders, pipe racks bent with stairs, caged ladders, catwalks of iron trapdoors, lever valves, oil puddles of black concrete under black stained glass, yellow-black warning banners, broken barrels, smoke from campfires under hatches, sagging chain cables, patrolling security guards. MINE BLOCKS: crying obsidian - a breach in the yard that weeps purple drops. HERO LANDMARK: a 40-block distillation column broken in half, a flare stack burning beside it. SUMMIT: the control building roof. MOOD: smoggy dusk, dirty and dangerous.
